breeze.cockpit: the pod at the front of the chest
breeze.name: Breeze
breeze.note: Retired (owner, 2026-10-24: "Breeze me h sucks"); kept while the game still loads it.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.note: Mining Mike's Uber mech, ported: the reference.
bulwark.weapons: slab shield and siege fist (L), breaker cannon (R)

driller.name: Driller
driller.note: Block-out 6, built in detail at 24 m, armed: a derrick on its back.
driller.opening: the Panorama clamshell, chest and cockpit as one: the lower flap folds down below the sill, the hood swings up

foreman.cockpit: Panorama: seated behind one wide screen and square side screens, in the chamfered prow
foreman.legs: digitigrade, three segments, double hydraulic rams, track-pad feet
foreman.name: Foreman
foreman.note: Original, after an excavator: slewing ring, broad shoulders with beacons, an engine pack and its stack. Recommended.
foreman.opening: the Panorama clamshell, chest and cockpit as one: the front under the screens drops into a step, then the front over them swings up and out on two rams with the dash

harrow.cockpit: Canopy: seated under a bubble in the hull's nose
harrow.legs: digitigrade, heavy slabs and rams, wheel feet
harrow.name: Harrow
harrow.note: Block-out 1, built in detail at 24 m (owner, 2026-10-24: "1,2,6,8,11,12 start building them").
harrow.opening: the canopy and the hull's nose over it lift back as one
harrow.weapons: autocannon pod (L), heavy cannon pod (R), a six-cell missile rack on each shoulder

ironhorse.cockpit: Excavator cab: seated, floor-to-roof screens in two rows and one in the floor
ironhorse.legs: digitigrade, drive-wheel knees with coupling rods, cow-catcher shins
ironhorse.name: Ironhorse
ironhorse.note: Original, after a steam locomotive: a banded boiler torso, smokestack, dome, headlamp, firebox pack.
ironhorse.opening: the dogs swing off, the smokebox front drops forward as a ramp with the cab's front on it

mule.cockpit: Excavator cab, under a canopy roof
mule.name: Mule
mule.note: Block-out 8, built in detail at 24 m: a haul truck's dump bed on its back.
mule.opening: the cab's front drops below the sill as a flap
mule.weapons: two piston fists, a rocket pod on each shoulder

picket.name: Picket
picket.note: Block-out 11, built in detail at 24 m: a Gundam's build, none of its badges.
picket.opening: the Panorama clamshell: the lower flap folds down, the hood swings up
picket.weapons: machine gun with a box magazine (R), tall shield (L)

ravager.cockpit: low head, visor under three eyes
ravager.name: Ravager
ravager.note: Mining Mike's rival Uber mech, ported: the reference.

roustabout.cockpit: Titan: seated, the upper front rises and tilts back
roustabout.name: Roustabout
roustabout.note: Block-out 2, built in detail at 24 m.
roustabout.opening: the chest over the screens rises and tilts back with the turret's collar, the front under them drops below the sill
roustabout.weapons: piston fist (L), heavy rifle with a box magazine (R)

sapper.legs: human knee, heavier, knee guards, skirts
sapper.name: Sapper
sapper.note: Block-out 12, built in detail at 24 m: bolt-on armour.
sapper.opening: the chest over the screens rises and tilts back, the front under them drops below the sill
sapper.weapons: rifle (R), missile pod on the forearm (L), cannon over the right shoulder

stevedore.cockpit: harness: standing in the octagonal prow
stevedore.name: Stevedore
stevedore.note: Original, after a dock crane: gantry, counter-jib and weights, warning lamps.
stevedore.opening: the four lock rods turn out, the prow splits into two doors
stevedore.weapons: cargo mortar (L), crane jib with a harpoon grapple (R)
